newsitem.title: USA: American Air rejects pilots' regional jet offer.
newsitem.headline: American Air rejects pilots' regional jet offer.

text.p: American Airlines Thursday rejected an offer by its pilots to compromise on the contentious issue of who will fly the carrier's new regional jet planes.

The pilots' union late on Wednesday said it would be willing to allow union pilots to fly the regional jets at lower pay as a step toward reaching a new contract and avoiding a strike set for midnight Friday.
American Airlines spokesman Al Comeaux said the offer was not a proposal but simply a concept. "It was a bunch of verbiage on paper," he said.

American Airlines wants to buy a fleet of small jets for its regional carrier, American Eagle, and fly them with lower-paid pilots belonging to another union, a move opposed by the Allied Pilots Association, which plans to strike after midnight Friday if no agreement is reached.
The airline said it needed the low-cost operation to be competitive with other major airlines flying low-cost commuter services.
